entities.summary: King Wu, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Zhou Dynasty (1046 BCE–771 BCE). Preceded by Mandate of Heaven and Battle of Muye — King Wu defeats the Shang and establishes the Zhou dynasty. Their legacy influenced Spring and Autumn Period and Confucius born in the state of Lu; his teachings shape Chinese civilization.
